author: Ecckos
quote:
Worst GTA Ever! A Life Simulator, Dating Simulator, and Male Humiliation Simulator.

Zero fun, zero freedom, almost zero gangster action.

Half the game is spent dealing with Jason’s house, which belongs to Brian and which Lucia moves into, buying flowers and doing household shopping. Hell, there’s even a cutscene where you put groceries away in kitchen cabinets. WTF happened? Where’s the gangster attitude?

Jason is one of the most shallow protagonists in gaming. A former soldier who dreams of a quiet, easy life instead of having any real criminal ambitions. Seriously? This is a GTA protagonist?

Lucia and Jason come from completely different worlds. She wants money, criminal success, and to climb higher. He offers her a quiet life, dinners, and shopping, while she wants to take part in heists. When Jason refuses to take her along, she says she’ll handle things herself. Their ambitions couldn’t be more different.

Lucia’s goals and the future she wants for herself seem to come before the relationship. Jason, meanwhile, looks like a guy who has no idea what he wants and increasingly lets the relationship dictate his life.

You get the impression that Jason wouldn’t even mind if Lucia slept with another guy while he sat in the corner watching. Total cuckold!

Lucia fits perfectly into a certain model of modern Western relationships that is increasingly criticized today. Personal ambitions and convenience come first. The partner is expected to adapt, support, and follow along, even if it means abandoning his own plans. That’s exactly the kind of arrangement I find repulsive. A relationship should be based on mutual effort, not one person pursuing their ambitions while the other simply follows. Jason increasingly looks like a man who has lost his identity by subordinating himself to Lucia.

This isn’t a partnership. It’s yet another story about a man who has to subordinate himself to a woman.

Rockstar became so obsessed with their relationship that it created a separate system for developing their bond. Dates, holding hands, spending time together, maintaining the relationship. WTF?! How much more is missing before this becomes a full-blown dating simulator? Am I buying GTA or some teenage romance game?

And the criminal underworld? Influencers, female rappers, viral videos, social media, fame, clubs, and businesses. Even the criminal world feels like show business and reality TV. Instead of the streets and the gangster atmosphere, we get celebrities and internet personalities. WTF happened to GTA? Is this supposed to be **** GTA?! 

How is this a rom-com instead **** game? How low can you sink?

The game has been feminized, and aside from its beautiful graphics and a few interesting mechanics, it’s simply terrible.

The game is liberal, so forget about freedom. NPCs are protected, too. You can’t kill protesters. Try running them over and your car automatically brakes. Shoot them? They’re invincible. Clubs also restrict weapon use, so forget about starting a proper shootout.

A gangster game with a morality system, where certain choices can lead to a bad ending. Seriously? All that’s missing is a good-behavior meter and a reward for being a model citizen.

The storyline revolves mostly around the relationship between these two “protagonists.” Instead of gangster chemistry and uncompromising characters, we get romance, everyday chores, and emotional drama. 
The gangster elements are pushed into the background. 

This is a feminist fantasy. The story feels like a romance novel written for women. The relationship between Lucia and Jason takes center stage while the actual gangster story takes a back seat.

You could honestly get the impression that the game was paid off by liberal feminists.

A horrible, humiliating experience that forces you to perform everyday chores, when people play games precisely to escape that kind of crap.

Gaming is going downhill. A gangster game has turned into a dating simulator with a forced feminist agenda, a life simulator with a few heists thrown in. Rockstar has abandoned its identity. This is closer to The Sims than to previous GTA games.

It feels like Rockstar forgot what made GTA special in the first place.

This isn’t GTA VI. It’s GTA SIMP Cuckold Feminist Rom-Com Simulator.

My proposed new name: SCFRS.

My rating: 0/10. Why so low? Because this was supposed to be GTA, and it simply isn’t.

It’s like MasterChef: if the challenge requires a dish made with mussels but you serve chicken, you get zero points. That’s exactly how I’m judging this game. It failed to deliver what it was supposed to be. 

If this were a separate game, my rating would be much higher. But it isn’t what we were promised.

If it weren’t called GTA, it would never have achieved anything close to this level of success.

It failed to live up to the identity and expectations associated with the GTA name. 

That’s why I simply cannot give it a higher score.
